summary.text: Kent Udell is the Democratic nominee for Utah's 3rd Congressional District. Born in Lehi, he is a University of Utah-trained engineer and professor of mechanical engineering who has served on federal advisory boards.

paragraphs.text: Earned a bachelor's degree and a Ph.D. from the University of Utah, according to his Ballotpedia profile.
Career experience includes working as a professor of mechanical engineering and serving on federal advisory boards.
Advanced from the Democratic primary without appearing on the ballot after the June 23, 2026 primary was canceled.
